email.subject: Which CAM software for relief carving? The honest 2026 comparison
email.intro:
The internet will tell you Aspire is the standard for relief carving. That is true, and for most people it is also two thousand dollars more than they need to spend.

We rewrote our comparison of Aspire, VCarve, Carveco and Fusion 360, with Easel and Carbide Create added because people keep asking. What each one actually does with a relief file, the 2026 prices, the catches nobody mentions on the box, and three plain recommendations depending on what you carve.
